verdict.rationale: cubic's own CLI lets developers connect an existing ChatGPT Plus/Pro or Claude Code subscription and use those models for local reviews, so a choice between two providers' models is documented. That choice is limited to local CLI reviews. Ultrareview's 'most capable review models' are picked by cubic, not the user. missing for 10: model selection for GitHub PR reviews and chat, explicit per-model picking beyond connecting a subscription, broader provider list, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can choose which underlying AI model powers my session from multiple providers

citations.quote: Connect your existing **ChatGPT Plus/Pro** or **Claude Code** subscription to use its models for local reviews.
The **cubic CLI** reviews local changes before you push.
